observations.fact: Rifle pitches sharply muzzle-up on screen right; support hand reaches under/behind the pistol grip toward the rear magazine.
Rear magazine is withdrawn down-left on screen while firing hand stays on pistol grip; hand and lower edge obscure part of extraction. Rifle remains nearly upright.
Replacement magazine comes from below/left and is pushed into the rear socket behind the grip; HUD changes from 18 to 27 between 5.5 and 5.6 seconds.
Rifle lowers back to HIP, support hand recovers. Camera also pans down/right, so world motion is not used as a weapon transform.

mechanism.evidence: Visible rear-magazine exchange in actual footage, corroborated by current W138 semantic source and rear position z=10.94..13.34 behind grip center z=8.285; group membership alone is not used.

authoredApproximation: All numerical Euler angles, local translation amplitudes and smoothstep interpolation are authored from visible poses, not extracted animation.

Source camera bob, ADS exit and moving player yaw/pitch are not copied. Native model framing is pending.
